presentation: Captioned still-frame walkthrough of actual browser captures, not a continuous real-time recording.
wallet: Disposable injected test-wallet harness. Phantom extension not verified.

scenes.title: Approve the work.
scenes.subtitle: Then release the payment.
scenes.body: A product-listing service for small sellers. One photo, a clear agreement, and the buyer’s final say.

scenes.title: A useful sample, clearly labeled.
scenes.subtitle: No wallet. No live transactions.
scenes.body: The walkthrough shows the brief, fixed specification, previews, validation and sample receipt. Synthetic sample artwork is disclosed.

scenes.title: Agree before depositing.
scenes.subtitle: 5 mock USDC. Explicit deliverables.
scenes.body: One 1600² hero. Three social formats. Title, description and five bullets. A validation report, manifest and private ZIP. Quote and refund deadlines are separate.

scenes.title: Review the actual submitted pack.
scenes.subtitle: Four previews bound to the receipt.
scenes.body: This recorded order uses deterministic fixture generation. It proves the escrow and delivery flow, not runtime AI.

scenes.title: Checks support your judgment.
scenes.subtitle: They do not prove quality or truth.
scenes.body: Dimensions, file counts, copy limits and SHA-256 hashes are checked. Review product identity, aesthetics and every claim before approving.

scenes.title: Only the buyer releases payment.
scenes.subtitle: Download the exact committed files.
scenes.body: A separate transaction releases exactly five tokens. A different one-use signature authorizes the private ZIP. Reload and worker restart preserve access.

scenes.title: Then stop the merchant API.
scenes.subtitle: Recovery still talks directly to Solana.
scenes.body: Recorded worker PID 7632 exited. Health probe: ECONNREFUSED. Merchant requests from the recovery page: 0. Original buyer signs the refund.

scenes.title: The deposit comes back.
scenes.subtitle: Exact amount. Finalized Refunded state.
scenes.body: A separate expired order returns 5,000,000 token units to its original buyer. Merchant balance is unchanged. Refunds require a buyer transaction.

scenes.title: AI creates. The buyer decides.
scenes.subtitle: Solana enforces the payment rules.
scenes.body: Live AI verification remains pending a configured provider key. Hashes bind agreement and bytes. Storage availability still matters. Upgradeable, unaudited prototype; no real USDC value.

scope: Draft artifact only. No video published or hackathon entry submitted.
